welcome_page.description:
Traffic, cycle lanes, road surfaces and other road users when you ride an e-scooter.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name, and no public authority receives them.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

questionnaire.title: E-scooter – Road and personal safety

questions.text: When you ride an e-scooter, how quick are your reflexes if something happens suddenly?
questions.help: For example a car door opening suddenly, a vehicle cutting across you, or a junction where you can't see what's coming.

options.text: Not quick at all: I often cannot react in time
A little quick: sometimes I react late
Fairly quick: I usually react in time
Very quick: I almost always react in time
Extremely quick: I always react in time

questions.text: How good are the cycle lanes and paths on your usual e-scooter route?
questions.help: Think of cycle lanes, cycle paths and their signs and markings.

options.text: There are none, or almost none
There are some, but they stop and start or are badly made
They cover part of my route
They are good on most of my route
They are very good all along my route

questions.text: What gets in your way on your usual e-scooter route?

options.text: Potholes, bumps or cobblestones
Steep or sudden slopes
Cars or vans parked in the cycle lane
Pedestrians walking in cycle lanes
Bins, signs or boards in the cycle path
No crossings or traffic lights for bikes
Badly designed junctions or roundabouts
Tram tracks
Edges of the sharing area, so I cannot leave the vehicle where I arrive
Stairs or steps on the route with no ramp or wheel channel
Nothing gets in my way

questions.text: When the road surface is bad, what do you do on the e-scooter?
questions.help: For example potholes, cobblestones or uneven ground.

options.text: It doesn't affect me
I notice it, but I don't change anything
I slow down or ride around it, on the same route
I take other roads, even if they are longer
It limits where and how often I can ride

questions.text: Does heavy or fast traffic on your route change how you ride your e-scooter?

options.text: No, traffic doesn't bother me
I notice it, but it rarely changes my comfort or route
It sometimes makes riding less pleasant
It often makes me feel stressed or unsafe
I change my route or time to avoid it

questions.text: When you ride an e-scooter, who on the road makes you feel unsafe? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Car drivers
Motorcycle or scooter riders
Bus drivers
Delivery vehicles (vans, cargo bikes, scooters)
Taxi or ride-hailing drivers
Cyclists
Other e-scooter riders
Pedestrians
Nobody in particular

questions.help: Think of specific behaviour, such as passing too close or not giving way, rather than everyone in a group.

questions.text: When you ride an e-scooter, which of these situations make you feel unsafe? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Poor visibility or limited sightlines
Unsafe behaviour from drivers, riders or pedestrians
Crowding
Conflicts with other road users
No emergency services nearby

questions.text: When you ride an e-scooter after dark, does poor street lighting change your route or when you ride?

options.text: No, it makes no difference to me
I notice it, but I don't change anything
I ride slower or keep to better-lit roads
I take a much longer, better-lit route
I don't ride after dark because of poor lighting
I don't ride after dark for other reasons

questions.text: During the day, do you ever feel unsafe from crime or harassment when you ride an e-scooter? (Harassment includes unwanted comments, following, touching, or intimidating behaviour directed at you.)

options.text: Yes
No
Doesn't apply to me

questions.text: In the evening or after dark, do you ever feel unsafe from crime or harassment when you ride an e-scooter?

options.text: Yes
No
Doesn't apply to me

questions.text: When you feel unsafe in the evening, what do you change?
questions.help: You can choose more than one answer.

options.text: I change my route
I change the time
I share my location with someone
I ask someone to come with me
I use a different means of transport
I give up going out
Nothing
Prefer not to say

questions.text: When you ride an e-scooter, what makes you feel less secure from crime or harassment? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Places with few people around (isolated or deserted areas)
People behaving aggressively or in an intimidating way
Blind corners or obstructed views
Poor maintenance (e.g. abandoned buildings, graffiti, broken infrastructure)
No surveillance or security measures (e.g. no cameras, no staff)
Incidents that happened to me or were reported in the area
Overcrowded or chaotic places
Few cues to find my way without sight (e.g. no tactile paths or audio announcements)

questions.text: When you ride an e-scooter, have you experienced or do you fear harassment because of who you are or how you look (e.g. gender, appearance, origin, age)?

options.text: Yes
No
Doesn't apply to me
